OCCT's optimal box, asked for with no tolerance, reaches the whole sphere's extreme along y, past the plane y = -15.435 where the common ends, and the closed-form box ends at that plane. The oracle's README records this weakness on trimmed spherical faces.

In this common, the cut circle passes within 0.165R of a pole of the sphere (along z), and OCCT's area misses the closed form by more than the case's 1e-6. The closed form is recomputed independently to 3e-12 and was checked by quadrature in the corpus inventory, and no cap or lens case further from a pole disagrees on volume or area.
